name: @rhythmjs/events
description: Fully typed event bus for Rhythm on the native node:events engine (Bun-optimized): template-literal-typed wildcard subscriptions, dual emit semantics, and AbortSignal unsubscription. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: bun build src/events.ts src/types.ts --outdir dist --root src --format esm --target node --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build
